QuestInfo.name: [Water Thief Monster] Mysterious Masked Thief
QuestInfo.0: You decided to learn more about Water Thief Monsters. Talk to #b#p9000292##k.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to #bSurl#k of #bEdelstein#k, the main victim of Water Thief Monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Surl told you about #bmoisturizers#k. Your skin isn't that bad, though...

0.msg: What happened? Oh, the Water Thief Monsters? They're the worst. Stealing water is like the meanest thing you can do. And no matter how hard we try, we can't keep them out!

1.msg: But the weird part was... Well, my assistants told me that they would leave behind moisturizer. There are no labels and the tags are super cheap. No way it's store-bought.

2.msg: That's all I know. I'm just so sick of them!
